relatedNodes.html: While most Latin Americans are naturally family-oriented, Medellin women are probably a step higher.
Upon being in a serious, loving relationship with one, she’ll want you to meet her parents right away. And it's not just her parents, rather her entire family.

However, don’t let this gesture intimidate you as it only shows how important you are to her. Plus, it’s a great sign that she cherishes you as she decided to introduce you to the most important people in her life.
If the Medellin woman you are dating has not introduced you to her family yet, don’t lose hope. The best thing to do is not rush things, and simply wait for the pieces to fall into place.
The best time to meet her family is when you ask her out on a date.

Always make sure to pick her up from her place during your dates. This gives her the opportunity to let you meet her family in person. Not only does it show her that you are a gentleman, it also shows that you are not afraid to meet her family.

Once she feels comfortable around you, she’ll eventually let her walls down and when the time is right, she’ll treat you as a part of her family as well. When that happens, you’ll soon realize how loyal and caring they are when it comes to family.
Some people may think that being religious is a bad thing, but the truth is, it is only bad when it becomes radical.
Religious people tend to be more peaceful. They strive to do good as followers of their faith.

More than half of the people of Colombia practice Catholicism, and as such, women are more conservative and humble. They also know that in order to get respect, they have to be respectful towards others as well.
Most importantly, they believe that love is at the center of everything. And who wouldn’t want love to be the center of their relationship?
As with most Latin households, children are taught to do household work at a young age. This is to instill in them the value of responsibility.
They learn how things are done at a young age, and in growing up, the sense of responsibility is inculcated in their mindset.
Living under the same roof as a Medellin woman means living in a well-kept home.
When she gets comfortable with you, you can be sure that she will take care of you.
She will ask you how your day was, fix you something to eat, and give you enough time to rest.
Because of their upbringing, Medellin women have an innate maternal instinct that somehow allows them to know your needs.
You might be wondering why being jealous is considered a good trait.

There is no question about how most Medellin women tend to be jealous. They think that whatever is theirs should be theirs alone. While some may see this as a bad thing, thinking about its positive effects say otherwise.
This is good for you because you will know that she doesn’t want to lose you.

Being jealous is a sign that she is afraid of losing you to someone else. This usually leads to her wanting to please you more, and when she wants to please you, she’ll make sure that you are well taken care of.
